title: Binary value modulo eight
statement: For every finite Boolean word $w$, the remainder of its binary value upon division by $8$ is $\operatorname{val}(w_0)+2\operatorname{val}(w_1)+4\operatorname{val}(w_2)$, where $w_i$ is the bit in position $i$ starting from the first position, and a missing bit is taken to be false.
